item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump; Paramount settles merger lawsuit
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have sued Trump after the networks were suspended from the White House. Paramount makes concessions to resolve a lawsuit.

item.title: Inside a 'modern slavery situation' where cyber scammers are victims themselves
item.description: Wired's Andy Greenberg explains how a cybercrime operation in Southeast Asia trapped computer engineers into defrauding victims of billions of dollars.

item.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 over 2019 Easter bombings
item.description: The Islamic State-inspired attacks were among the deadliest in Sri Lanka's history, killing 42 foreigners.

item.title: Trump's D.C. arch now a military complex, complicating matters
item.description: The future of Trump's D.C. arch was already uncertain. After he rebranded it as a military complex, experts say legal and logistical issues have increased.
